'''Easter eggs''' on Decipher Star Wars CCG cards are hidden jokes, call-outs, and extra images that have no effect on play. Yellow circles on the photographs are the Collecting Encyclopedia's callouts. Decipher posted an official list through [[Jabba's Palace Limited]]; later finds are collector notes.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref><ref name="artshow">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020222145840/http://www1.decipher.com/artshow/eastereggs/starwarsccg/index.html Star Wars CCG Easter Eggs] at Decipher.com (archive, 22 February 2002)</ref>

Card titles that scramble employee and fan names are listed separately at [[Anagrams]].

== A New Hope Limited ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Image !! Card !! Egg
|-
| style="text-align:center; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:EE-Bespin-Motors-Void-Spider.png|220px]] || [[Bespin Motors Void Spider THX 1138]] || "THX 1138" is the title of George Lucas's first major film. THX is also Lucas's theatre sound system, and Luke told the Imperial officer they were transferring Chewie from cellblock 1138.
|-
| style="text-align:center; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:EE-Dark-Waters.png|220px]] || [[Dark Waters]] || Ewok doll floating in the dark waters.
|-
| style="text-align:center; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:EE-Defel.png|220px]] || [[Defel]] || Hidden on the uniform shoulders are the letters "WYOU" and "XERB". WYOU was Wolfman Jack's first radio station (circa 1960) in Virginia; Decipher is in that broadcast area. XERB is the station he was on later in California, where George Lucas heard him and put him in ''American Graffiti''.
|-
| style="text-align:center; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:EE-Death-Star-Trench.png|220px]] || [[Death Star Trench]] || "The Art of Great Games" is one of Decipher's trademarks and motto.
|-
| style="text-align:center; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:EE-Hyperwave-Scan.png|220px]] || [[Hyperwave Scan]] || The X's and O's create a tic-tac-toe game.
|-
| style="text-align:center; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:EE-Lukes-Hunting-Rifle.png|220px]] || [[Luke's Hunting Rifle]] || The Campbell's soup can reads "Cream of Womprat". Joseph Campbell, who influenced Lucas's mythology, is an additional egg.
|-
| style="text-align:center; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:EE-M-HYD-Binary-Droid.png|220px]] || [[M-HYD Binary Droid]] || "(C) 11111001100 DECIPHER, INC." — 11111001100 is 1996 in binary.
|-
| style="text-align:center; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:EE-Retract-The-Bridge.png|220px]] || [[Retract The Bridge]] || The lights spell VERTIGO (what Luke and Leia felt, and an Alfred Hitchcock reference).
|-
| style="text-align:center; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:EE-Scanner-Techs.png|220px]] || [[Scanner Techs]] || Hidden letters "WBN", call letters of the radio station from ''Radioland Murders''.
|-
| style="text-align:center; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:EE-Sensor-Panel.png|220px]] || [[Sensor Panel]] || Light and Dark card backs are images of SWCCG cards. "ANEWHOPE" can be found in the digital mileage readout.
|-
| style="text-align:center; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:EE-Tzizvvt.png|220px]] || [[Tzizvvt]] || Alien icon has multiple eyes.
|-
| style="text-align:center; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:EE-Undercover.png|220px]] || [[Undercover]] || "Good Evening" written vertically, with Hitchcock's profile shadow — the opening of ''Alfred Hitchcock Presents''.
|-
| style="text-align:center; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:EE-Yavin-4-Briefing-Room.png|220px]] || [[Yavin 4: Briefing Room]] || Extra people were added: Matt Mariani (former Decipher Marketing Director); Ronald Reagan; Bob Hudsol; Warren Holland (Decipher Chairman and CEO). To the right of the viewscreen, Jerry Darcy (Decipher Star Wars design team) stands in the shadows.
|-
| style="text-align:center; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:EE-Youre-All-Clear-Kid.png|220px]] || [[You're All Clear Kid!]] || 253 in the center bottom of the image is Decipher's street address (253 Granby Street).
|}
